OUR STORY

Wellness that fits
into your world.

Madero Slim UAE is a home service wellness business specialising in Deep Detox, Lymphatic Drainage and Madero Therapy.

PERSONAL BY NATURE

Your space.
Your kind of care.

We believe that making time for yourself can feel simple. Our home sessions bring body-focused care and relaxation to you, without the journey to a spa.

From wooden Madero tools to soothing massage, our collection gives you room to choose a ritual around your own comfort and preferences.

We welcome ladies and couples across Dubai, Sharjah and Ajman.
